about.title: About Texas Elite Insurance Agency
text: Texas Elite Insurance Agency is a locally owned and operated independent agency. We are able to offer our clients various options to best suit their individual needs. We represent a variety of trusted A-rated carriers which allows us to provide our clients with a selection of choices.

There’s a reason our customer retention is the best in the industry – we aren’t your average insurance agency. We take our role in your life and business with the utmost sincerity and seriousness. You’re not another commission, your customer satisfaction is our priority. We’re your advisor, advocate, and lifelong insurance partner. Let us change how you feel about insurance.
Please use our customer service center to view your insurance policies, print insurance ID cards, update your contact information, download documents, and more.
